verdict.rationale:
Phaser's docs and community evidence show 2D is the core, native workflow: dedicated Scene system, Arcade physics with velocity/gravity/acceleration, sprite creation via this.add.sprite, tilemap/atlas support in the asset loader and editor, animation manager, and a unified input system — all framed as first-class concepts rather than bolted-on extras. Community feedback corroborates this ('2D, sprites, tilemaps, physics' as Phaser's defining strength, 'best for 2D games'), and there's no mention of 3D at all, confirming 2D-only focus rather than an afterthought.
missing for 10: no dedicated docs on tilemap editor internals or matter.js/other physics engines beyond Arcade, and no independent benchmark specifically validating 2D performance claims.
